issue_context.title: Nina - please add attributes for "Handlungsempfehlung" and "betrofffene Regionen"
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Important information from https://warnung.bund.de is published under "Handlungsempfehlung" and "Betroffene Region(en)" but is not included in the integration. Would it be possible to add attributes for this?

I live in Hamburg and the NINA service is not clustering the city into smaller parts. This means, that often warnings actually are not relevant for me. However, inside of the "warning" the section for "betroffende Regionen" can be quiet accurate and could be filtered by Home Assistant to react only if the warning is relevant.

I would like to use the attribute for "Handlungsempfehlung" for two things:
1. My house has an automatic ventilation system. I want Home Assistant to turn it of whenever Nina has the word "Fenster" in Handlungsempfehlung. Currently I filter the attribute "description" for hints if the ventilation system should be off. But there are many possible cases (smog, smelling, bombs, gas, radio activity...) and it would just be more reliable if the word "Fenster" could be filtered.
2. Alexa could read this information.  

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2022.12.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

NINA

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nina/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

This is a warning information for Hamburg that is not relevant for my location and that would include this information inside of "Betroffene Region(en)". In this case the word "Fenster" is additional only available in "Handlungsempfehlung".

https://warnung.bund.de/meldung/mow.DE-HH-HH-SE033-20221208-33-000/Starke_Rauchentwicklung_durch_Gro%C3%9Fbrand_im_Bereich_Hamburg_-_Tonndorf,_Sonnenweg

So this doesn't actually filter the result more than making a `True` or `False`?

Should it not be saved to coordinator results so the `binary_sensor` can trim down the result further?

Yes, this is the intended function. If the filter detects a region the message is forwarded, if not it is ignored.
I don't see why the message should be filtered further in binary_sensor.

It's not obvious that's how it works. 
I think you should open a doc PR and add information about how this works. 
Current doc doesn't say that much and also the string you added for the config flow doesn't tell that much either.
